title: Lawn Care Software Cost 2026: Free to $648/mo, Compared
description: How much lawn care software costs: published prices for Yardbook, LawnPro, QuoteIQ, Jobber, Service Autopilot and LMN, with yearly cost for solo and crew.
h1: How much does lawn care software cost?
body:
Short answer: from free to several hundred dollars a month. Solo operators can start on a free plan (Yardbook Starter or LawnPro Solo); crew-based landscaping platforms like LMN start at $297/mo. Every figure below is the vendor's published list price, re-checked on 2026-10-30 where the pricing page was readable (Yardbook, LawnPro, QuoteIQ, Service Autopilot) and otherwise taken from our last check shown on each tool page. Prices exclude tax, card processing and add-ons. For features and our full write-up, see best lawn care software and the lawn care hub.

Yearly cost for a solo operator (1 user, list prices)

  • Yardbook Starter or LawnPro Solo: $0 (LawnPro Solo caps you at 25 customers; Yardbook adds a 1% fee on online payments for free accounts, on top of Stripe fees).
  • QuoteIQ Essentials: $299.99/yr billed annually, or $359.88/yr month to month ($29.99 × 12). {{aff:quoteiq|Try QuoteIQ}}
  • Jobber Core: $348/yr billed annually ($29 × 12) or $588/yr monthly ($49 × 12).
  • Yardbook Business: $419.88/yr ($34.99 × 12, annual plan). It waives the Yardbook payment fee.
  • LawnPro Startup: $468/yr monthly ($39 × 12).
  • Service Autopilot Startup: $588/yr ($49 × 12, annual subscription rate).

Monthly cost for a small crew (about 4 people)

  • QuoteIQ Pro: $199.99/mo includes 4 users, plus QuickBooks and chemical tracking.
  • LawnPro Grow: $129/mo monthly ($99/mo billed annually) with 7 employee logins and multi-step chemical programs.
  • Jobber: extra users are $29/mo each; Jobber also lists 5- and 10-user tiers of Connect and Grow (see Jobber pricing).
  • Service Autopilot Pro: $199/mo with 1 business user and 2 mobile licenses; extra license prices aren't published.
  • LMN Starter: from $297/mo with 6 licenses, plus onboarding.

Costs on top of the subscription

  • Card processing: Jobber lists 2.9% + 30¢ online; most others don't publish rates (unknown).
  • QuickBooks sync: Yardbook Enterprise only; LawnPro add-on below Plus (price unknown); Service Autopilot call-for-pricing below Elite.
  • Onboarding: LMN charges a one-time fee (amount unknown).

faq: How much does lawn care software cost per month?

Published prices run from free (Yardbook Starter, LawnPro Solo) to $29.99-$49/mo for one-user plans (QuoteIQ, Jobber, Yardbook Business at $34.99, Service Autopilot Startup at $49) and up to $297-$648/mo for LMN's crew plans, checked October 2026.
Is there free lawn care software?
Yes. Yardbook's Starter plan is free, and LawnPro's Solo plan is free for 1 user and up to 25 customers with no credit card.
What is the cheapest lawn care software with QuickBooks?

From published prices: Yardbook Enterprise ($49.99/mo on an annual plan) includes QuickBooks sync; QuoteIQ includes QuickBooks from Pro ($199.99/mo); Jobber includes QuickBooks Online sync from Connect.
Do lawn care software prices include payment processing?
No. Processing fees are separate. Jobber lists 2.9% + 30 cents online; Yardbook adds a 1% fee on free accounts on top of Stripe fees; other vendors don't publish rates.
